description: Defines the SubunitTreeModel class, which converts a collection of Subunit entities into a hierarchical tree structure for API serialization.

classes.name: SubunitTreeModel
classes.description: A model class that transforms a flat list of Subunit entities into a nested tree structure suitable for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an array of Subunit objects.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the collection of subunits into a hierarchical tree array.

methods.name: toTree
methods.description: Recursively builds a nested tree from a collection of Subunit objects based on their levels, organizing children under their respective parents.
